54625885784.description: CR531659-65. Von Winning Kirchenstück GG 2013 is quite possibly the finest Riesling I have ever tasted (96/100). It is a wine of great depth and length, offering an expressive profile of ripe peach, sweet lemon, and tropical fruit, all supported by a subtle touch of oak in the background. A lively, well-preserved acidity adds freshness and structure. The 2013 vintage predates the winery’s shift—around 2017—towards extended barrel aging, which in some later vintages can allow vanilla and oak notes to dominate more prominently. Here, however, they remain refined and beautifully integrated.
